overview: A vertical three-lane racing game where you steer a red sports car, dodge descending traffic, and chase a rising score.
features: Vertical three-lane road with dark gray surface and white lane markings
Red sports car player vehicle at the bottom of the road
Traffic cars that spawn at the top and move down automatically
LEFT and RIGHT buttons plus arrow keys to change lanes
Live score at the top that rises as you avoid traffic
Collision detection with a GAME OVER overlay and final score
Restart button that resets the score and starts a new game
Traffic speed and spawn rate that increase with your score
Engine, collision and background music sounds with a music toggle
Responsive touch-friendly layout for Android phones
